tools.name: inventory_read
tools.description: Read current inventory for the authenticated user's pantry location. Returned product names are canonical and must be used exactly for shopping-list changes. This tool never writes memory.

tools.name: shopping_list_read
tools.description: Read the authenticated user's scoped Grocy shopping list.

tools.name: shopping_list_change
tools.description: Apply a compound add/remove request to the authenticated user's list and independently verify the resulting Grocy state. Product names must exactly match canonical names returned by inventory_read. If a name is rejected, read inventory and retry with the canonical name; a rejected request makes no changes.

tools.name: infrastructure_read
tools.description: Read current synthetic infrastructure observations for the authenticated user's domain. observation_state describes observation availability and freshness, not target health: ERROR means the source failed to provide an observation and is not evidence that the target is unhealthy. Read health only from a returned value; preserve FRESH, STALE, UNKNOWN, and ERROR without inferring missing values.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Read one explicitly stored memory in the authenticated user's domain.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Find relevant explicit memories for the authenticated user using a natural-language query when the exact key is unknown. Results are limited to that user's domain and a small bounded set; use a returned key for a correction, and never treat memory as live operational truth.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Upsert an explicitly requested memory in the authenticated user's domain. When correcting an existing memory returned by memory_search or memory_read, reuse that exact memory_key so the existing value is updated; do not create a second key for the same preference. Treat the returned value as confirmation of what was stored.

tools.name: task_start
tools.description: Create an authoritative durable task for the authenticated user.

tools.name: task_resume
tools.description: Resume by reading the authenticated user's canonical task identity and checkpoint.

tools.name: task_checkpoint
tools.description: Persist a task checkpoint and state in the canonical ledger.

tools.name: commitment_submit
tools.description: Submit one exact-effect synthetic commitment after the protected fixture has issued a current approval bound to its task, user, target, and material details. An uncertain acknowledgment enters quarantine and must be reconciled; never blindly retry.

tools.name: commitment_reconcile
tools.description: Read the protected simulated target's canonical state for one quarantined effect and reconcile it without replaying the operation.

tools.name: workspace_exec
tools.description: Run one bounded shell command in the authenticated user's disposable, isolated Git repository. The workspace has no network egress or production credentials; inspect after a timeout instead of blindly repeating a possibly partial command.
